title: Manasse's Reign and Idolatry
description: Manasseh became king of Judah at twelve years old and reigned for fifty-five years. He reintroduced widespread idolatry in Jerusalem, built altars to Baal and the host of heaven in the temple of the Lord, set up an Asherah pole, made his son pass through fire, and shed innocent blood. The Lord spoke through the prophets and pronounced a severe judgment against Jerusalem and Judah. Finally, Manasseh died, and his son Amon became king after him.
